method: Direct visual review of source pages1–2 against first-pass eng OCR; developmental sample, no held-out accuracy claim.
findings: Page1 explicitly reserves village-president offices under GO107; clipped/scanner-overlaid cover text is partly missing in OCR.
Page2 is a two-column English GP-president roster. Many category cells survive, but OCR interleaves left/right columns and changes names and some SC cells to SE.
Printed Kancheepuram first GP Valathottam is OCR Malathottam; its ST (General) category survives.
Printed Devariyambakkam category SC (Women) is OCR SE (Women).
decision: Raw extraction feasible; full 2006 run not started. Column separation and source-validated category/name guards needed before semantic parsing. Include No254 errata before treating base reservations as final.
